speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing acute diarrhea; to help me determine the cause, how long have your symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (Clostridioides difficile infection). Given the recent levofloxacin use for community-acquired pneumonia, I recommend immediately testing for C. diff toxin. REQUEST TEST: C_diff_toxin_assay
